title: Manifold Welcomes T.J. Ladusky & Andrew Hendry to Form All-Star Sales Team
body_markdown:
There is a version of a freight tech sales hire that looks good on paper: someone who can talk the talk, work a booth at a conference, and put together a clean demo. And then there is the kind of hire that changes the trajectory of a company: someone who has actually dispatched loads, built carrier relationships from scratch, and sat on both sides of the negotiating table. That second kind of person is rare. We just hired two of them.


T.J. Ladusky and Andrew Hendry officially joined the Manifold team this fall, and they have not wasted a single day ramping up their pipelines.


### T.J. Ladusky: Fifteen Years of Freight, and Still Hungry to Change It


T.J. brings fifteen years of freight brokerage experience to Manifold; a career that has run through Echo Global, Penske, Transplace, Uber Freight, NFI, and Fitzmark. That resume is not a collection of job titles. It is fifteen years of covering freight, building books of business, managing carrier relationships, and delivering for customers when the market got tight and options got scarce. He has been the broker on the phone at 10pm trying to cover a load. He knows exactly what it feels like when your technology fails you at the worst possible moment.


Since joining Manifold in September, T.J. has already been on the road. He attended the McLeod User Conference and TIA Technovations alongside Manifold CRO Trey Griggs, and he has been on the ground in Texas meeting face to face with carriers and brokers who are already running on the platform. He is not learning this industry. He is speaking its language from day one.


*“I came to Manifold because I believe that every carrier and broker in our industry should have access to technology that can change the trajectory of their business and the lives of their employees.”*


That belief is not abstract for T.J. He has watched carriers and brokers get buried under a dozen open bid boards, chasing spot freight with tools that were never designed to help them win. He came to Manifold because he has seen what that problem costs people, and he knows what solving it is worth.


### Andrew Hendry: He Talked to Our Customers Before He Said Yes


Andrew Hendry spent four years at TextLocate, where he grew from BDR to Account Executive and helped the company triple revenue in twenty-four months. Before that, he was on the operations side at Steam Logistics. The majority of his career has been spent selling technology directly to freight brokers and trucking companies; not pitching at conferences but sitting in their offices, understanding their workflows, and figuring out exactly where the software they had been sold had let them down.


Andrew started at Manifold just last week. Before he signed on, he went and talked to brokers and carriers already using the platform. He wanted to hear what they actually thought, not what the deck said. What he heard convinced him.


*“I came to Manifold because I believe in the product we've built and the vision we have moving forward. I've seen a lot of technology in this space fall short of providing value. After speaking with customers on the platform already, I was convinced Manifold is a game changer and truly providing considerable impact to brokers and carriers today.”*


He talked to our customers before he said yes. That tells you something about Andrew, and it tells you something about what those customers are saying.


### Already Building Pipeline, Already Moving the Needle


Together, T.J. and Andrew have already built nearly three-quarters of a million dollars in opportunities since joining the team. Manifold's goal is to reach $2 million in closed ARR by February 2027; a number that would double the company's current annual recurring revenue. With two salespeople who know this industry at the carrier and broker level, who have walked the floors at McLeod and TIA, and who have already been sitting across the table from real customers in Texas, that target is not wishful thinking. It is a plan with the right people executing it.


Trey Griggs, Manifold's Chief Revenue Officer, put it plainly.


*“We are insanely focused on customer success, and that starts with having the right people carrying the message. T.J. has lived the problems our customers face every single day. Andrew has spent years sitting across the table from brokers and carriers, hearing exactly what they need. Together, they bring a depth of credibility and conviction that is going to resonate; and that is going to move the needle for our customers and for our team.”*


### What This Means for the People We Serve


For the carriers and brokers running on Manifold, this means more people in your corner who have worked freight the same way you work freight. T.J. and Andrew are not here to walk you through a feature list. They are here to understand your operation, help you get the most out of the platform, and make sure Manifold is delivering the kind of value that shows up on your bottom line.


The freight industry runs on relationships built over years of doing the work together. The people representing Manifold should be the kind of people this industry wants to build those relationships with. T.J. and Andrew are exactly that.


Welcome to the team. Let's get to work.


Want to see what Manifold can do for your brokerage or carrier operation?[Schedule a demo](https://www.getmanifold.ai/contact) and see what your team has been missing.
